description: This file contains the implementation of functions for configuring and retrieving user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch chip, including setting and getting the formats and data offsets for these selectors.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Sets a user-defined field selector in the HSB (High-Speed Bus) by configuring its format and offset, given an index (0-15).

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a user-defined field selector, returning the format and offset for the specified index.

ctags.name: rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32* pFormat, rtk_uint32* pOffset)$/

ctags.name: rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32 format, rtk_uint32 offset)$/
